descriptionMarkdown:
Equipment 
Grade Typical Replacement
Issued
If the character still has an appropriate 
patron or institution, ordinary class 
equipment and common ammunition are 
normally replaced between authorised 
missions without a roll.
Controlled Usually replaced with a routine Requisition 
test, paperwork or a short downtime action.
Scarce
Requires a Requisition test and a plausible 
supply source. Replacement may be 
delayed, substituted or issued only for a 
mission.
Rare
Requires strong access, Standing, a 
specialist source or a specific reward. Loss 
should matter.
Exceptional
Normally a campaign objective, patron 
decision, inheritance, major favour or 
difficult project rather than a routine request.
Near-Unique / 
Unique
Cannot be assumed replaceable. Recovery, 
reconstruction or replacement should be a 
story in its own right.
